name: Sunbreath
subtitle: an oxygen maker for clinics, run by sunlight

effects.effect: sponge-like crystals with a huge inner surface trap one chosen gas

effect: sponge-like crystals with a huge inner surface trap one chosen gas
how: Pneumonia kills hundreds of thousands of children a year, many in clinics with no steady electricity to run an oxygen machine. Sponge-like crystals that grab oxygen but let nitrogen pass soak it up from cool air in the shade; a curved mirror then warms them in the sun and they breathe out nearly pure oxygen into a storage bag, with two beds taking turns so the bag also covers the night.
obstacle: The crystals that pick out oxygen this well break down in humid air within months.
why: Oxygen-binding crystals exist; no electricity-free, sun-driven oxygen concentrator does.
real: Found MOF oxygen-capture reviews (incl. temperature-swing release), solar-panel oxygen concentrators and sun-driven MOF water harvesters, but nothing on a sun-heated sorbent oxygen concentrator.
